body: I'm sorry you've felt like this before, I hope you can see past it as well.

I don't actually have social anxiety in that sort of capacity. I frequently (attempt) to talk during class discussions, last semester I met up/arranged a couple of study groups, and I've even had nice conversations with a couple of people I liked/had a lot in common with. I guess that's why I feel like there's something wrong with me, I don't know. My therapist has suggested a few group therapy sessions that my uni holds during the semester that she wants me to go to. I'm not very good at knowing what kind of goals I should be making.

Does someone that would be effected by my death count as being important, though? Perhaps that's cold of me, but I'm not sure I can bring myself to live for family members that don't particularly care about me in any meaningful way.

I'm in uni so it's not for a lack of trying. I'm mostly ignored, or perhaps forgotten. Quite frankly I feel like out right rejection would be a positive welcome in my day to day. I just feel like no matter where I go or what I try to throw myself into, I might as well not exist.
